name: Aaron Williams
title: Founder & Lead
bio:
Aaron Williams is the Founder & Lead of Smart Meme Token, a revolutionary project that redefines the meme coin category by fusing viral internet culture with tangible blockchain utility. He recognized that the explosive energy of meme communities could be harnessed not just for speculation, but for building decentralized applications, funding creative projects, and rewarding active participation through intelligent tokenomics. Under his leadership, Smart Meme Token introduces AI‑powered community governance, automated liquidity strategies, and a creator monetization engine that empowers artists and developers to launch meme‑based micro‑economies.

With a background in software engineering, digital marketing, and community building, Aaron has deep experience in launching and scaling tokenized projects that capture the zeitgeist. He has previously led marketing campaigns for top‑tier DeFi protocols and has been an active participant in the NFT and meme coin space since its inception. Smart Meme Token is built on the principle that memes are the lingua franca of the internet — and when combined with smart contracts, they become programmable cultural assets that can coordinate millions of people around shared humor, values, and economic incentives. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition, Aaron shares his vision for the next wave of meme‑driven economies that are as sophisticated as they are fun, proving that a token can be both a community inside joke and a serious financial instrument.

name: Abdoulaye NDIAYE
title: Economics Professor
bio:
Abdoulaye NDIAYE is Assistant Professor of Economics at NYU Stern School of Business. His research focuses on macroeconomics, public finance, development, and political economy — with a growing body of work on blockchain economics, including transaction fee mechanisms, parallel execution, and the design of price- versus quantity-based controls for decentralized systems.

Prior to joining NYU Stern in 2019, he was a Research Economist at the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and later served as Senior Advisor to Senegal’s Minister of the Economy, Planning and Cooperation. He holds a PhD in Economics from Northwestern University and degrees from École Polytechnique in Paris. A Visiting Scholar at the United Nations, Harvard, and Princeton, he has been recognized as one of Africa’s leading young economists (NextGen Best African Economist Under 40) and awarded the Yuki Arai Faculty Research Prize in Finance. His blockchain research has been presented at Financial Cryptography conferences and a16z crypto events.
headline: Bridging Macroeconomics, Public Finance & Blockchain Economics
subtitle:
NYU Stern School of Business
Macroeconomics • Public Finance • Blockchain Fee Design
quote: “Understanding incentives and constraints is essential — whether designing optimal taxation or more efficient blockchain fee markets.”

name: Adam David Reiser
title: Founder & CEO
company: Verity One Ltd. / Made in USA Inc.
bio:
Adam David Reiser is the Founder and CEO of Verity One Ltd. and Made in USA Inc., pioneering AI- and blockchain-powered platforms for supply chain transparency, product origin verification, and environmental asset tokenization. Under the mottos “TRUTH MATTERS™” and “TRUST BUT CERTIFY™,” his companies deliver institutional-grade certification systems, Country of Origin Labeling (COOL), Made in USA Certified® standards, and the innovative Nutrient Credit model that monetizes oyster-based water cleanup and coastal restoration.

A U.S. Navy veteran with a career spanning electronics, aerospace systems, and enterprise IT, Adam has spent decades building technology that enforces accountability across regulated industries. Verity One’s solutions — including the Veritze™ platform, Verity Wallet, and tokenized Nutrient Credits monitored by AI, IoT, and satellite data — are deployed or planned across the Chesapeake Bay, UAE, Puerto Rico, Monaco, and other global regions. He also achieved the milestone of certifying the first “Made in USA Certified®” Bitcoin, extending provenance standards into digital assets.

With deep experience in large-scale software engineering and AI systems, Akhil focuses on bridging the gap between simple intent recognition and true multi-hop reasoning agents capable of planning, tool orchestration, and complex decision-making. His contributions help shape how modern platforms move beyond reactive AI toward proactive, reliable agentic intelligence that can operate safely and effectively in real-world production environments.

name: Aliya Grig
title: Founder
bio:
Aliya Grig is the Founder of Ocean, a groundbreaking blockchain infrastructure platform that modernizes cross‑border trade finance. She is on a mission to close the $20 trillion global trade finance gap by replacing the archaic, paper‑based system of letters of credit, bills of lading, and factoring with programmable, transparent, and automated smart contracts. Her vision is a world where any small or medium enterprise (SME), anywhere, can access fair and instant trade financing against verifiable on‑chain collateral.

With a background in international trade law, supply chain logistics, and distributed systems, Aliya has witnessed firsthand the friction that kills trillions in economic potential — days of settlement, fraud, and the exclusion of promising businesses from global markets. Ocean’s infrastructure digitizes trade documents as NFTs, escrows payments in stablecoins, and uses oracles to track shipments in real‑time, triggering instant settlement upon delivery. The platform also tokenizes trade finance assets, allowing institutional investors to fund invoices and receivables with full transparency and risk scoring. Aliya is a passionate advocate for trade as a force for inclusive globalization. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition she outlines how decentralized trade finance can be the killer application that finally brings blockchain to the heart of the global economy.

With a rare multidisciplinary background spanning economic theory, artificial intelligence, and distributed ledger technology, Angele’ has advised governments, Layer‑1 protocols, and large‑scale DAOs on the fundamental architecture of their economic models. title: CEO, Advisor, Author, Professor
bio:
Annelise Osborne is the CEO of Osborne Capital Partners and a distinguished advisor, author, and professor who stands at the intersection of traditional real estate investment and blockchain‑powered capital markets. With decades of experience structuring complex real estate transactions, advising institutional investors, and teaching the next generation of finance professionals, she is now leading the charge to tokenize commercial and residential real estate assets — unlocking liquidity, fractional ownership, and global access for one of the world’s largest asset classes.

Annelise’s career spans senior roles in real estate investment banking, private equity, and asset management, where she has been responsible for deploying billions of dollars into real estate debt and equity. She also serves as an Adjunct Professor at a leading business school, bridging the gap between academic theory and market practice. Annelise believes that tokenization is not a threat to traditional real estate but its natural evolution. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition, she provides a masterclass on how institutional capital is embracing on‑chain real estate and what it will take to bring the next trillion dollars of property onto the blockchain.

name: Benjamin Smith
title: Chief Business Officer
bio:
Benjamin Smith is the Chief Business Officer at Coinsub, the pioneering infrastructure platform that brings the $275 billion subscription economy onto the blockchain. He leads business development, strategic partnerships, and enterprise adoption of Coinsub’s smart contract‑based recurring payments and streaming money protocols — enabling businesses to accept programmable, borderless, and automated billing without relying on traditional card networks or banks.

With over 15 years of experience in fintech, payments, and SaaS business models, Benjamin has held senior commercial roles at leading payment processors and e‑commerce platforms. He recognized early that the subscription business model was fundamentally incompatible with legacy banking rails — plagued by chargebacks, cross‑border friction, and high fees — and that blockchain’s native capabilities (streaming payments via EIP‑1337, programmable money, and automated smart contracts) would unlock the next trillion‑dollar wave of recurring revenue. Coinsub offers plug‑and‑play integration for Web2 companies transitioning to Web3 and for DAOs, protocols, and dApps that require recurring funding, payroll streaming, and grant distribution. Benjamin is a recognized voice on tokenized business models and has advised Fortune 500 companies on how to introduce crypto subscriptions without alienating mainstream users. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition he reveals how recurring payments are the killer use case that finally bridges the gap between everyday commerce and decentralized finance.

bio:
Brandon Nebeker is the US Growth Lead at Tangem, the world’s premier manufacturer of smart card cold wallets. He is on a mission to eliminate the fear and friction that have kept millions of potential crypto users on centralized exchanges — by introducing them to Tangem’s sleek, credit‑card‑shaped hardware wallets that combine bank‑grade security with a tap‑and‑go user experience. Under his leadership, Tangem is rapidly expanding its footprint in the United States, empowering a new generation of holders to truly own their digital assets without needing a PhD in cryptography.

With over a decade of experience in business development, fintech partnerships, and consumer technology, Brandon has a track record of scaling high‑growth hardware and software companies from early traction to mass adoption. At Tangem, he leads retail strategy, strategic alliances, and community engagement, ensuring that the revolutionary Tangem wallet — which uses a secure EAL6+ chip and NFC communication with a mobile app — is available, understood, and trusted by everyday investors. He believes that the future of crypto depends on making self‑custody as simple as tapping a phone, and that hardware wallets should be both an accessory and a fortress. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition, Brandon shares the secrets to breaking the mass‑market barrier for cold wallets, the importance of design‑led security, and why the ultimate expression of “not your keys, not your coins” is a wallet you can physically hold in your hand — and never lose sleep over.

title: CEO and Co-founder
bio:

By collecting thousands of data points per second, Ahura personalizes content delivery to match each learner’s optimal state, attention, and format — scaling one-on-one quality education for enterprises and nations.

Under her leadership, Bolts is solving the fragmentation problem plaguing blockchain — delivering enterprise‑grade nodes, cross‑chain messaging, and data availability solutions that allow different networks, applications, and real‑world systems to interoperate seamlessly and at lightning speed.

With a career that spans telecommunications, distributed systems, and blockchain architecture, Yoon brings a unique engineering‑first perspective to the CEO role. She previously led platform engineering at a major telecom provider, overseeing the deployment of edge computing and 5G infrastructure before diving into the crypto space. At Bolts, she has steered the development of a highly optimized validator network, a universal RPC layer, and a novel cross‑chain transaction protocol that reduces finality time to under 200 milliseconds. Yoon is a strong proponent of open standards and works actively with the Linux Foundation and the Ethereum Enterprise Alliance. She believes that the critical missing piece for mass adoption is not another L1 or L2, but a unified, robust infrastructure grid that connects them all. At Blockchain Week - UNGA Edition she presents the Bolts blueprint for the physical and digital fabric that will power the next billion users of Web3.
headline: Bolting Together the Decentralized World: Modular Infrastructure for Web3 Scale
subtitle:
Bolts Technologies
High‑Performance Web3 Infrastructure • Modular Protocols • Interoperability
signatureMoves: Built a global validator network with sub‑200ms finality
Created the Universal Cross‑Chain Message Protocol (UCCMP)
Former VP of Platform Engineering – Tier‑1 Telecom
Speaker: The Interoperability Grid for Web3
quote: “We don’t need more blockchains. We need a universal infrastructure grid that makes every chain, every app, and every device work together with the reliability of a global public utility. That’s what Bolts delivers.”

name: Katie Hilborn
title: Founder & Managing Director
headline: Building AI Data Centers That Regenerate the Places They Power
tagline: Founder & Managing Director • Regenerative Infrastructure Holdings
subtitle:
Regenerative Infrastructure Holdings
Building AI data centers that regenerate the places they power
bio:
Katie Hilborn is Founder and Managing Director of Regenerative Infrastructure Holdings, which builds Regenerative Intelligence Infrastructure™ — a new class of AI data center designed to circulate value rather than extract it, powered by restorative energy and governed by Community Trusts.

She originated an AI data center powered by hydro already serving rural and at-risk communities in Nepal, then formed the joint venture and, with her co-founder, built the capital-formation architecture and Community Trust structure now anchoring RIH’s model globally. Across twenty years in international development, fifteen centered on Nepal — including the 2015 earthquake response — where she originated and completed three critical-infrastructure projects. Her work also spans Uganda and Bolivia.

A ten-time award-winning humanitarian, she has spoken at SXSW, the AI Infra Summit and family-office summits in Dubai, Cannes and Miami. Her work has been covered by New York Magazine, NBC, ABC and USA Today Network.
signatureMoves: Originated Hydro-Powered AI Infrastructure in Nepal
quote: “AI infrastructure should do more than consume energy and extract value — it should regenerate the communities and environments that make intelligence possible.”

name: Kelly Ye
title: Chief Investment Officer
headline: Building the Capital Layer for Onchain Finance
subtitle:
Coinbridge
Building the capital layer for onchain finance
bio:
Kelly Ye is Chief Investment Officer at Coinbridge, which is building the capital layer for onchain finance by bringing high-quality real-world assets onchain and constructing portfolios designed to meet investors’ risk-and-return objectives.

She has nearly twenty years of experience in investing and product design spanning traditional finance and crypto, with leadership roles at Avenir Group, Decentral Park Capital, Fidelity Digital Asset Management, CoinDesk Indices, Goldman Sachs and New York Life Investments. Kelly holds a master’s degree from MIT and is a CFA charterholder.
signatureMoves: Leadership Across Crypto and Traditional Finance
quote: “Bringing real-world assets onchain is not just a tokenization exercise — it is about building portfolios with the quality, discipline and outcomes institutional investors expect.”

name: Thuy Pham
title: Managing Director
headline: Connecting Emerging Technology with Real-World Public Value
subtitle:
VEGA Corporation
Connecting emerging technology with real-world public value
bio:
Thuy Pham is an entrepreneur and business executive with international experience across Vietnam, India, Cambodia, Ghana, Nigeria and the United States. Her work spans fintech, blockchain, banking, digital transformation and innovation that connects technology with real-world impact.

Throughout her career, she has worked with startups, financial institutions and government agencies to develop innovation ecosystems and support inclusive economic growth. She co-founded FADO Go, a blockchain e-commerce company that provides loyalty solutions to businesses. She currently leads the development of a large-scale cultural infrastructure project combining culture, education, technology and community engagement through collaboration between government and private-sector partners in Vietnam.

As a speaker, Thuy has appeared at blockchain and innovation conferences in Vietnam and internationally, advocating for decentralization and practical applications that improve everyday life.
quote: “Emerging technology earns public trust when it moves beyond theory and creates visible, inclusive value in people’s everyday lives.”

name: Ashvin Dhawan
title: Chief Revenue Officer
headline: Bridging Traditional Card Rails and Onchain Settlement
subtitle:
Coinsub
Bridging traditional card rails and onchain settlement
bio:
Ashvin Dhawan is Chief Revenue Officer at Coinsub, a white-label stablecoin payment infrastructure company. With more than twenty years in payments across JPMorgan, Fiserv and NMI, he works at the intersection of traditional card rails and onchain settlement.

He helps payment service providers and acquirers bring stablecoin acceptance to merchants. A born-and-raised New Yorker, he lives in an apartment overlooking the United Nations.
signatureMoves: More Than Twenty Years in Payments
Experience at JPMorgan, Fiserv and NMI
quote: “The future of payments is not card rails versus blockchain — it is infrastructure that lets merchants use the best of both without adding friction.”

name: Muneer Basha Shaik
title: SAP SuccessFactors LMS Technical Consultant Lead
headline: Bringing Agentic AI into Enterprise Learning and Analytics
tagline: SAP SuccessFactors LMS Technical Consultant Lead
subtitle:
Independent Speaker, USA
Bringing agentic AI into enterprise learning and analytics
bio:
Muneer Basha Shaik is a Technical Consultant with sixteen years of experience spanning enterprise ERP systems, reporting and analytics, middleware administration and AI-driven learning solutions. He currently works as an SAP SuccessFactors LMS Technical Consultant Lead, where he architects enterprise-scale learning solutions and has designed AI-powered Copilot Agents for conversational assistance and intelligent reporting discovery across SAP BusinessObjects and Microsoft Power BI ecosystems.

Earlier in his career, Muneer led SAP SuccessFactors Learning configuration and compliance reporting initiatives, developed chatbots and RPA solutions using Kore.ai and Blue Prism, and managed Oracle WebLogic administration, Docker and Kubernetes containerization, and CI/CD pipeline integration. He began as a mainframe developer working on COBOL-based payment settlement applications for the retail and energy sectors.

Muneer holds a Master of Technology in Software Systems from BITS Pilani and a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science Engineering from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University.
signatureMoves: AI Agents for BusinessObjects and Power BI
From COBOL Settlement to Agentic AI
quote: “Enterprise AI becomes valuable when it helps people find the right knowledge, understand complex systems and act with confidence inside the tools they already use.”

name: Samuel Jacques-Cloutier
title: Digital Asset Policy & Governance Advisor
headline: Policy and Governance Done Right Means Asking the Hard Questions
tagline: Digital Asset Policy & Governance Advisor • Hash Directors
subtitle:
Hash Directors
Policy and governance done right means asking the hard questions
bio:
Samuel Jacques-Cloutier has advised the Cayman Islands Government on digital asset regulation, anti-money-laundering policy and financial-services reform for the last seven years.

He led the creation, drafting and implementation of Cayman’s Digital Asset Regulatory Law, including recent amendments introducing tokenized funds to the jurisdiction. He brings deep knowledge of global regulatory standards and a thorough understanding of government policy to today’s innovators.
signatureMoves: Seven Years Advising the Cayman Islands Government
Led Cayman’s Digital Asset Regulatory Law
Deep Knowledge of Global Regulatory Standards
quote: “Good digital asset policy starts by asking the hard questions early — before innovation scales faster than governance can respond.”

name: Andrei Seoev
title: Co-Founder & CEO
headline: Returning Extractable Value to Pools and Liquidity Providers
subtitle:
MEV-X
Returning extractable value to pools and liquidity providers
bio:
Andrei Seoev is the co-founder and CEO of MEV-X, where he leads product development and research. He has co-authored papers on DeFi, liquidity-provider economics and maximal extractable value, and created the MEV Explorer for EVM chains.

Since 2023, MEV-X has operated as a searcher, running live atomic and CEX–DEX arbitrage strategies across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Base and other EVM networks.

In 2025, the team applied this experience to build MEV-X Homelander, a plugin that enables AMM pools to capture their own extractable value and redistribute it to pool owners and liquidity providers instead of allowing it to leak to validators and external searchers. Before entering crypto, Andrei worked at SAP and Upstream Solutions.
quote: “MEV should not be value that automatically leaks from a pool — it can be captured by the protocol and returned to the owners and liquidity providers who created it.”

name: Charles Garrett
title: Founder & Product Engineer
headline: Making Advanced Financial Tools Approachable and Trustworthy
subtitle:
PeerFolio
Making advanced financial tools approachable and trustworthy
bio:
Charles Garrett is a founder and engineering leader building PeerFolio, a savings and investing platform designed to make advanced financial tools feel approachable and trustworthy. With a background spanning computer science, human-centered design and enterprise software, his work is shaped by lived experience growing up without access to wealth-building infrastructure.

Charles speaks and builds at the intersection of financial technology, equity and product design, with a long-term vision of communities across neighborhoods and generations using present-day fintech with confidence.
quote: “Advanced financial tools only create opportunity when people can understand them, trust them and use them with confidence.”

name: Rosalyn Brown
title: Luxury Real Estate & Tokenization Specialist
headline: Opening Global Access to Luxury Bahamian Real Estate
tagline: Luxury Real Estate & Tokenization Specialist • BHHS Bahamas
subtitle:
Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Bahamas
Opening global access to luxury Bahamian real estate
bio:
Rosalyn Brown brings more than twenty-five years of experience in offshore private banking, followed by six years specializing in luxury real estate in The Bahamas. Since 2015, she has been actively involved in blockchain and Web3 technology, bridging traditional finance and digital assets. She is crypto-certified and has spoken at Blockchain Futurist Conference in Miami and Toronto, as well as Future PropTech in Miami.

She is currently structuring a $40M-plus tokenized resort development in The Bahamas, combining luxury real estate with blockchain technology under the DARE Act framework. Her understanding of the Bahamian regulatory landscape, including the DARE Act and SEC compliance for U.S. investors, helps her navigate the complexities of tokenizing real-world assets.

Rosalyn has appeared on podcasts and radio programs in The Bahamas discussing the intersection of real estate, blockchain and the future of investment in the region.
signatureMoves: More Than Twenty-Five Years in Private Banking
Six Years in Luxury Real Estate
quote: “Tokenization can turn world-class real estate into a more accessible and liquid opportunity while preserving the regulatory trust serious investors require.”

name: Andrew Melnychuk-Oseen
title: Founder
headline: Building Toolsets for the Next Stage of Humanity
subtitle:
SaagaSolve
Building toolsets for the next stage of humanity
bio:
Andrew Melnychuk-Oseen is the Founder of SaagaSolve, where he is building toolsets for the next stage of humanity. An early Bitcoin investor and active angel investor, he began his career in the video game industry, working at the intersection of art and computer science.

As AI, multi-agent systems and cryptocurrency converge, he has become increasingly focused on how these technologies are reshaping civilization — and what must be built to navigate that transition well. Andrew sponsors AI safety research for multi-agent systems and cryptocurrency. At AGI-26, he presented “Enlightenment 2.0” on how the structural infrastructure of civilization evolves.
quote: “AI, multi-agent systems and cryptocurrency are converging into a new civilizational layer — our responsibility is to build the tools that help humanity navigate it well.”

name: Lala Bregvadze
title: Chief Compliance Officer
headline: Scaling Innovation, Intelligence, Trust and Accountability Together
subtitle:
Pave Bank
Scaling innovation, intelligence, trust and accountability together
bio:
Lala Bregvadze is Chief Compliance Officer at Pave Bank, where she helped build the compliance, legal and governance architecture of a technology-led commercial bank operating across traditional banking, payments and digital assets.

Her work sits at the intersection of institutional strategy, financial regulation, technology, AI governance and programmable finance. A Cornell Tech graduate with multiple law and business degrees and advanced international compliance qualifications, she focuses on designing financial institutions in which innovation, intelligence, trust and accountability can scale together.
quote: “Innovation and compliance are not opposing forces — the strongest financial institutions are designed so intelligence, trust and accountability can scale together.”

name: Alok Tibrewala
title: AI Systems & LLM Architect · Applied Researcher
headline: Translating AI Research into Production-Ready Architecture
tagline: AI Systems & LLM Architect · Applied Researcher
subtitle:
Cybersecurity · Java · Cloud Systems
Translating AI research into production-ready architecture
bio:
Alok Tibrewala is an IEEE Senior Member and software engineer working at the intersection of AI systems, software architecture and applied research. His work focuses on designing and evaluating production-ready LLM-based systems in Java ecosystems, including agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented pipelines and AI-driven analytics.

He has published peer-reviewed research at IEEE conferences including IEEE CAI, CSCloud and EDGECOM, covering AI security architectures, anomaly detection and secure edge-cloud systems. He regularly speaks on translating AI research concepts into real-world architectures, including system-design trade-offs, reliability, cost control and evaluation of AI-assisted software systems.

Alok contributes as a researcher, speaker, reviewer and mentor, presenting technical material to both academic and industry audiences.
signatureMoves: Research at CAI, CSCloud and EDGECOM
quote: “An LLM system is not production-ready because the demo works — it is ready when security, reliability, cost and evaluation are engineered into the architecture.”

name: Anisha Salunkhe

tagline: Cloud Applications Architect / Delivery Consultant • AWS
subtitle:
AWS
Building resilient, scalable and responsible cloud applications
bio:
Anisha Salunkhe is a Cloud Applications Architect at AWS with more than eight years of experience building scalable solutions. She holds a B.E. in Computer Engineering from Pune and an M.S. in Information Systems from NYU, and previously worked as a Software Engineer at Mastercard.

At AWS, she has led projects across media, healthcare and enterprise technology — from content-delivery pipelines to HIPAA-compliant AI systems built with Amazon Bedrock. She holds eight AWS certifications across Professional, Associate and Foundational tiers and is passionate about generative AI, infrastructure as code and resilient systems at scale. She is also a mentor and advocate for women in technology.
signatureMoves: More Than Eight Years Building Scalable Systems
quote: “Generative AI only matters at enterprise scale when it is secure, resilient and designed for the realities of the people and industries it serves.”
